revivalfx wrote: I just want to clarify some terminology, before I start on this assignment.

What is the relationship with or difference between an engulf and a DBR RBD? From one perspective an engulf could be a part of a DBR.

Is an engulf just a dip in price or does it require an actual engulfing candle (which would affectively limit an engulf to a dip based on two candles). If it requires an engulfing candle, then an engulf could affectively be a peak and not just a dip. From what I remember, on the 5 or so videos I've watched, the reference to an engulf has only been a dip.

Yes...... I'm anal..... sorry.

OH that is my curious before but now clearly for me.Thank you.

Thanks Harry. That cleared it up. Engulfing refers to engulfing an entire supp or dem zone (wiping out the sellers and buyers) making a clear path for price to return through the area relatively unhindered.

Homework seems like a good idea to help me overcome confusion over terms, so I'm starting here. The first chart is a W1 with W1 DBR/RBDs in pink and DBD/RBRs in orange outline. The rest of the charts are D1 with D1 DBR/RBDs in blue (or orange where they overlap pink) and DBD/RBRs in silver outline. This took a lot of time and effort, which I'm not opposed to putting in, just really hopeful that this will help me and others!
